text: いきてる　じゃん　だったら　せめて　せんとう　ふのうに　してやるか！

structure.jp: せめて　せんとう　ふのうに　してやるか！
structure.en: I'll at least make them unable to battle!

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb means doing it to someone below you, often as a threat. してやる = 'I'll make them (so)'.

patterns.name: 〜じゃない
patterns.explanation: じゃん is a slangy short form of じゃない, said to point out something obvious: 'aren't they!'. いきてる　じゃん = 'they're alive, aren't they!'

patterns.name: 〜にする
patterns.span: ふのうに　してやる
patterns.explanation: に with する means to make something into that state. ふのうに　してやる = 'I'll make them unable'.
